thread:
jordan: Lia/Dastra — we got a cross-dock return in NL: 6 H100s under RMA. Vendor called out a repack surcharge. Need clarity on who covers E2E insurance vs inbound AWB consolidation fee and how this affects our EU allocation.
lia_vendor: Hi Jordan, confirm: vendor can cover repack labor/materials but asks Redwood to cover consolidation AWB surcharge + customs broker pickup. We can provide a proforma showing the split.
maria: @lia_vendor please upload the proforma and the AWB. Customs flagged potential HTS mismatch (8471 vs 8542) which changes duty.
sourcing: FYI — we have 12 units pending allocation for the EU reserved pool this quarter. If these are vendor replacements, does that reduce our incoming allocation or are they treated as separate RMA replacements? Impact on commit matters.
lia_vendor: Replacement units are same SKU. If you accept replacements we can release 4 from current allocation immediately; the other 2 require depot QA and will be released post-inspection. The rest are returns that will be processed through RMA.
eli: ops-bot created RMA RMA-2026-0042 for the returned batch.
ops-bot: RMA-2026-0042 created by lia_vendor. Status: inbound -> crossdock NL -> depot QA. ETA 2026-05-14 09:00Z.
maria: Customs preliminary estimate: brokerage surcharge €1,200 and insurance claim exposure ~€800. Vendor message says vendor covers repack only, not brokerage. Who is taking brokerage?
jordan: Proposal: vendor covers repack and inspection up to €2k, Redwood absorbs AWB consolidation + brokerage. Lia, can you confirm expected net invoice after vendor credit and whether vendor will reimburse duty if cause is DOA?
lia_vendor: Uploading breakdown by EOD. Early estimate: vendor credit line of -€1,500 for repack/partial damage allowance. Duty reimbursement only for DOA confirmed on claim.
sourcing: If Redwood covers brokerage, can procurement backcharge to code PROC-H100-EX? Need P&L impact on reserved commit.
eli: Tagging finance. @sara-finance can we use PROC-H100-EX for this brokerage line?
sara-finance: Finance confirms PROC-H100-EX can be used for incidental logistics up to €5k with SVP approval. Send final invoice and cost center.
jordan: OK, sounds like the path forward. Lia, upload final invoice and vendor credit memo, ops will route inbound shipments to depot QA once we confirm. :thumbsup:
lia_vendor: Uploaded files: ```AWB: NL234558900
Invoice: INV-88723
Proforma: PRO-5543``` Links posted to vendor-drive: https://drive.example.com/shared/returns/NL234558900
maria: I'll validate HTS and duty exposure; if duty applies and cause is transit damage, vendor says they won't cover duty — need final confirmation.
lia_vendor: Vendor policy: duty reimbursement applies only when unit proven DOA at origin. Transit damage/delivery mishandling not covered.
eli: Action items summarized: 1) lia_vendor — upload full invoice & credit memo (done), 2) maria — validate HTS and duty exposure, 3) sara-finance — approve PROC-H100-EX charge and confirm cost center, 4) eli/ops — route inbound to depot QA after docs OK.
jordan: Thanks all. We'll accept vendor replacement under these terms once finance signs off and customs clears HTS. Closing thread after acceptance. :white_check_mark:
